## 4. Appendix

### 4.1 Color Definitions

#### 4.1.1 Project Issue Colors

The following color scheme defines five severity levels for project issues:

| Level | Severity | Color | Description |
|-------|----------|-------|-------------|
| 1 | Blocker | 🔴 Red | Customer system crash, a product is completely unusable, or the customer is unable to work. SA and PE must immediately drop all current work to resolve this issue until it is fully resolved. |
| 2 | Major | 🟠 Orange | Significant impact on delivery or core functionality; major features are impaired. A complete initial response must be provided within 4 hours, and the issue should be resolved within 24 hours. |
| 3 | Normal | 🟡 Yellow | Noticeable impact but a workaround exists; the customer can continue working with limitations. Resolve by the date agreed upon with the customer; in principle, this should not exceed 2 weeks. |
| 4 | Minor | 🔵 Blue | Low impact; does not affect core functionality or daily operations. Unless there are no other tasks to execute in the project, this issue should be put on hold. If possible, decline the customer's feedback or request. |
| 5 | Trivial | 🟢 Green | Cosmetic or negligible impact; no effect on functionality or workflow. This type of customer request should be explicitly declined. |
